api_test_results.api_pattern: new SplitOptions() + AddInput(FileDataSource) + AddOutput(FileDataSource pattern) + new Splitter().Process()
api_test_results.IMPORTANT_FINDING: Splitter does NOT expand {0} as a format string. The output filename 'output_{0}.pdf' is used LITERALLY. api_test_results.splitter_output_naming_correction: Use 'output.pdf' as the output filename, not 'output_{0}.pdf'

key_findings.description: AddOutput() takes FileDataSource (IDataSource), NOT FileSaveTarget. Prior sprint documentation was incorrect.
key_findings.impact: All LLM code generation rules and code templates must be updated. FileSaveTarget is unusable in this context.

key_findings.description: SplitOptions.AddOutput does not expand format strings like {0}. The literal filename is used. Splitter produces a single output file.
key_findings.impact: LLM must use a simple output filename (e.g., 'output.pdf') for Splitter, not a format string.

key_findings.description: ResultContainer.ResultCollection (not OperationResult), no IsSuccess. Check Count > 0 for success.
key_findings.impact: Validator and LLM code templates must use ResultCollection.

key_findings.description: Unlicensed API adds 'Evaluation Only. Created with Aspose.PDF.' text. TextExtractor captures this. Validation must accept the known text at any position in the extracted content.
key_findings.impact: TextExtractor validation: use Contains() not Equals() for text matching.

key_findings.description: All 4 programmatic fixture strategies produce valid PDFs. The Aspose.Pdf.Document() API works without a license for simple content.
key_findings.impact: Fixture strategy is confirmed viable. No external fixture files needed.
